name: rpacker/epcis-parser-php
description: GS1 EPCIS 2.0 and 1.2 event generation and parsing library for PHP

scripts.format:staged: sh -c 'files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- "*.php") && [ -z "$files" ] || { echo "$files" | xargs -r ./vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --config=/home/robert/.vscode/.php-cs-fixer.php --path-mode=intersection && echo "$files" | xargs -r git add; }'
